Naslovi o poginulom pešaku na Novom Beogradu i ženi u požaru u Sremčici i stavke Danasa i Danubeograda nemaju lokaciju ni vreme koje mogu da povežem ni sa jednim instrumentom, pa ih ostavljam nepovezane. Naslovi RTS-a i B92 o ukidanju zabrane letova u SAD su van svakog lokalnog instrumenta koji imam. [F2][F10][F13][F31][F14][F17][F20][F23]

top.naslov: In the newest hour Pančevo Vatrogasni dom is lowest for both PM10 and PM2.5 at 7 [F4][F8], and Rakovica is highest for both at 22 and 21 [F4][F8], so the shared ends Observer saw are back, only at different stations. NO2 stepped harder than the particles, its maximum moving from 29 to 43 at Franše d’Epere [F6][F7], while the PM10 maximum moved from 19 to 22 [F5]. On a Saturday morning, a jump like that at a central station is more likely traffic near the sensor than anything spread across the city, though nothing in the record yet tells me what is usual for this hour [F48].
